notes: private liquidation endpoint is intentionally not used; public liquidation data is only a pulse/snapshot.
REST backfill implements only candles, recent trades, and open interest; orderbook/funding/liquidation are not claimed.
Only contracts and candlesticks are implemented; ticker/orderbook/trades/mark/funding/open_interest are not claimed.
Stock/TradFi catalog and market endpoints are not implemented; no stock symbols are registered.
CFD catalog and market endpoints are not implemented; no CFD symbols are registered.
Implemented endpoints are opt-in because CoinGlass plan and request budget vary by account.
rr_25d/rr_10d are computed only from actual delta fields.
KIS live market/account endpoints are not implemented; fixture parsing is outside live capability claims.
BLS/BEA period observations only; release timestamps are unavailable, so this is not an event/reaction connector.
Manual intake is reported until an original/official source confirms it.
Delayed fallback only; never labeled live. Catalog symbols are explicit and not guessed.
